title: Best TV Mount Guide
prompt: Wide-angle living room hero shot. A modern flat-panel TV mounted on a clean light-gray painted wall above a low walnut media console. The TV is tilted slightly downward and angled a few degrees to one side so the mounting bracket and arm are partly visible behind it, hinting at adjustability. Subtle soft daylight from a large window camera-left. Low sectional sofa with linen upholstery in foreground, woven area rug, indoor plant near the corner. Wide composition, eye-level, shallow but readable depth of field. Mid-century-meets-contemporary aesthetic. Cables hidden.

title: How to Reduce TV Glare in Bright Rooms
prompt: Bright sunlit living room interior at mid-morning. Tall floor-to-ceiling window camera-left throws strong directional daylight across hardwood floors. A large flat TV is mounted on the perpendicular wall so the screen faces away from the window, screen blank and dark. Sheer linen curtains partially diffuse the light. Bias-lighting LED strip glow visible behind the TV. Comfortable lounge chair angled toward the screen. Composition emphasizes the geometric relationship between window, wall, and TV. Warm but bright atmosphere, no lens flare.

title: Gaming TV Mounting Guide
prompt: Modern gaming room hero shot. A large flat-panel TV wall-mounted at lower-than-typical seated eye height on a deep charcoal accent wall. A sleek unbranded gaming console sits on a slim floating shelf below. A wireless controller rests on a tidy low coffee table. Ergonomic mesh-back gaming chair angled toward the screen. Soft cool-toned bias lighting behind the TV plus a warm floor lamp for contrast. Cable management visible but extremely clean. Wood floor, neutral rug. Medium-wide shot, slight downward angle. Late evening mood.

title: How to Mount a Soundbar Under a TV
prompt: Tight medium-close hero shot of a wall-mounted flat TV with a slim modern soundbar mounted directly below it on a discreet bracket. The soundbar is centered, perfectly aligned with the TV's width. Slim gap of two to three inches between TV bottom and soundbar top. Clean white wall, no visible cables. Light walnut media console below holds nothing more than a small ceramic vase. Soft warm side-lit daylight. Composition emphasizes the alignment, gap, and bracket geometry. Shallow depth, the wall and console softly defocused.

title: Open Floor Plan TV Mounting
prompt: Wide-angle hero of an open-concept great room. Kitchen island with marble counter in the right foreground, living area in the center-middle with a large flat TV mounted on a clean painted wall, dining nook implied in the background. The TV is on a swiveling full-motion mount slightly extended and rotated a few degrees toward the kitchen so it is visible from both zones. Sectional sofa, woven rug, large pendant light above the island. Natural daylight from unseen windows. Architectural composition showing the spatial relationship between cooking, lounging, and viewing zones.
